name: OKC_ARTICLES_ALL
description: This table stores all the clauses that are used for an organization. This includes the standard clauses that exist in the clause library as well as the non-standard clauses that are specific to a contract document. This table replaces the OKC_STD_ARTICLES_B/_TL used in releases prior to 11.5.10.

columns.name: ARTICLE_ID
columns.description: System generated Primary Key.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ARTICLE_TITLE
columns.description: The Title for the clause. This is unique for a given operating unit.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ARTICLE_NUMBER
columns.description: Clause Number - could be manually entered e.g. 55533.1 or generated using document sequence auto-numbering.

columns.name: STANDARD_YN
columns.description: Yes/No flag  to indicate whether the clause is standard or non-standard.

columns.name: ARTICLE_INTENT
columns.description: This is the Clause Intent i.e. Buy or Sell. Foreign Key to FND_LOOKUPS of lookup_type OKC_ARTICLE_INTENT.

columns.name: ARTICLE_LANGUAGE
columns.description: The language of the Clause. Foreign Key to FND_LANGUAGES (Base or Installed).

columns.name: ARTICLE_TYPE
columns.description: This is the Clause Type. Based on the FND_LOOKUPS with lookup_type of OKC_SUBJECT.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: This column is used to preserve the code for the migrated system.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: This column is used to preserve the identifier1 for the migrated system.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: This column is used to preserve the identifier2 for the migrated system.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
